3d_player_controller.subject:
Hide the chat window until it is wanted, and guard the blend position setter

chat.gd gains start_visible, off by default: a chat box is not wanted on
screen in a single player scene until something is said. Hiding it needed
three changes rather than one, because open_input bailed out when the window
was not visible so the chat action would have done nothing forever, an
arriving message would have been written into an invisible box, and the pause
handler set visible = not paused so the window reappeared the first time a
menu was opened and closed. It now opens a hidden window, shows itself when a
message arrives, and remembers what it was before a menu rather than
unhiding.

player.gd checks is_inside_tree before is_multiplayer_authority in the
sync_blend_position setter. The authority call asserts the node is in the tree
and an exported property is assigned while the scene is still being built, so
every single load logged the failed assertion.
